task.title: Error envelope: add Pack D §D21 i18nKey retryable userActionable fields
acceptance: Add three Pack D §D21 fields to error envelope output: error.i18nKey (string format errors.<CODE> e.g. errors.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND); error.retryable (boolean - true for transient codes like UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE RATE_LIMITED false for terminal codes like RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND VALIDATION_FAILED FORBIDDEN); error.userActionable (boolean - true when user can fix by retry or input change false when only operator can resolve);Define mapping table from 26 canonical ErrorCode to retryable plus userActionable boolean pairs and document in main.py header comment;Existing error.code error.message error.details unchanged; meta.correlationId unchanged;Contract test test_bff_error_envelope_shape.py extended to assert all three new fields present and correct types in 401 404 422 500 cases;Live verification after gh workflow run nonprod-deploy: curl /bff/strategies/__nonexistent__ returns error.i18nKey errors.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND plus retryable false plus userActionable true;Do not mark done if live response missing any of three fields
task.next: Completed: PR #577 delivered Pack D D21 error fields; PR #584 merged closeout evidence/review artifact; local focused tests and smoke passed; nonprod deploy run 26392125605 succeeded; live /bff/strategies/__nonexistent__ returned RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND with errors.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND retryable=false userActionable=true.
